description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and all referenced docs to discover mandatory Option Explicit On / Option Strict On / Option Infer On headers on every file. (2) Implement IProductRepository.vb with proper I-prefixed PascalCase interface name, Task-returning Function signatures, CancellationToken parameter, and XML doc comments. (3) Implement ProductNotFoundException.vb inheriting Exception with a ReadOnly Property for ProductId As Integer, two constructors (id-only calling MyBase.New with formatted message; id+innerException calling MyBase.New with both), and XML docs. (4) Implement ProductRepository.vb implementing both IProductRepository and IDisposable with the full protected Dispose(disposing As Boolean) pattern, _disposed As Boolean field, GC.SuppressFinalize(Me), _camelCase private ReadOnly fields, Async Function methods with ConfigureAwait(False), Using statements, Try/Catch with specific exception types ordered before general Exception, Throw New ProductNotFoundException, and method-syntax LINQ with Function lambdas — NO blocking .Result/.Wait(), NO Async Sub. (5) Implement ProductFactory.vb with Public Shared Function CreateProduct using Select Case branching and Case Else throwing ArgumentException. (6) Implement InventoryService.vb replacing the stub, with _camelCase ReadOnly field typed as IProductRepository, Task.WhenAll for parallel loading, CancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested(), Boolean naming using Is/Has/Can prefixes, no Hungarian notation, and XML docs. All namespaces must follow PascalCase hierarchical convention.
